title: aidia cochinchinensis f. angustifolia
intro: Aidia cochinchinensis f. angustifolia, commonly known as Chong Pei, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including the potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The therapeutic actions of Aidia cochinchinensis f. angustifolia include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified as the primary compounds contributing to its medicinal properties.
